description: Only when the shopper names a specific shop; for anything they want to buy, use search_catalog. Read-only shop directory by name. A listing proves no stock, price, delivery or checkout eligibility. Use search_catalog for product facts without store filters; it does not verify stock, price or delivery. Then call get_buying_options for both local_delivery and ship_to_home with the exact product_id, zip and quantity. Ask the shopper which verified mode they want; never ask them to select a source shop. For same-day, require an available local_delivery result. For ship-to-home, require an available ship_to_home result. After the buyer chooses an available mode, call start_checkout with the same product_id, zip, quantity and fulfillment_mode. JENNi resolves the source internally. Give the shopper checkout_url; nothing is charged until they place the order.

market.description: Market key, e.g. san-antonio-tx. Used when no zip is given.

name.description: Shop name or part of it, e.g. "Cheeky Monkey".

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code: searches the shops within 15 miles of it first, then the national list. Pass it for any shop outside San Antonio.

name: find_stores

partial.description: True when not every listed shop could be compared.

alias_store_ids.description: Other store ids JENNi folded into this same physical shop. Display only.

url.description: The shop's page on the storefront.

title: Find a shop by name
